src: const k = sketch('top'); k.rect(60, 40, { at: [0, 0] }); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('front', -3.3); sk.polygon([[14,10.5],[22.8,10.5],[19.3,20.3],[14,20.3]]); groove(sk, t, 135);

brep.refused: groove groove1: brep-rs supports only profiles parallel or perpendicular to the axis yet -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): the ring starts in the flat plane z = 0, which is also a flat face of the part, and a part turn cut from there does not come out reliably; lift the part off that plane by 1 mm or more, or turn the ring a full 360 degrees.
